title: Sync calendars (CalDAV)
description: Create, edit and delete appointments in Apple Calendar. Changes synchronize with Bauplan.
readonly: Tasks and quote deadlines are read-only. Edit them in Bauplan.
password: Use your existing Bauplan password. For SSO accounts, set a local password using “Change password” first.
setup: Apple Calendar: Add Calendar Account → Other CalDAV Account → Manual. Enter the server address, email address and your Bauplan password. On iPhone, go to Settings → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts.
limits: Supports single, all-day and multi-day appointments. Recurring appointments are explicitly rejected. Tasks and quote deadlines appear in a separate read-only calendar. No additional ICS import is needed.
https: Use HTTPS outside localhost. The server must be reachable by your calendar app.
copyFailed: Could not copy the server address.
timezone: The calendar timezone is configured on the server using CALDAV_TIMEZONE (default: Europe/Berlin). Changes appear after the next synchronization or refresh.
